[b]The Signal[/b]

After the latest series of Hijackings resulted in the partial destruction of kazaruk base, the 3 remaining prisoners were relocated to a new location in the east of Hydronia. After countless days of intense interrogation by the cobra team, Imran bin Salih, the eldest of the prisoners at an age of 65, finally gave into their demmands. He was able to supply the cobra team with a new Sal-Baliz communication frequency. This frequency had been in use since the previous ones were compromised by Etherniasti.

The next day, the team attempted to use the frequency to tune into a Sal-Baliz communication. After waiting for 2 hours, the team finally got a lock onto a signal. At first it produced nothing but white noise, but after a few minutes of adjusting various settings, they were able to get hold of a relatively clear audio clip. It appeared that the supreme leader was making an address to the Sal-Baliz.

"On this day, I hearby proclame the Islamic Caliphate of shamat! Togeth-"

It cut out again. A few minutes later the signal cleared up again, but only for a brief moment.

"I have order our troops to begin the journey towards Mecca! We will Liberate our rightful homeland from the illegitemate entity that is Irocco-"
